source_snapshot.procedure: Enable six EDKII debug/error-injection settings, deploy Intel ITP, boot into shell, start a Cscript log, halt, call parameterless ei.injectMCERR(), resume, then collect results/photos and inspect logs.

source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into shell 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on client 5. Using folling command >>>itp.log("C:\Test.log") >>>halt() >>>ei.injectMCERR() >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. System should crash and hang but reboot eventually 2. BMC error log should record CPU Catastrophic Error been detected 3. Front Panel fault Light will Light if there is one 4. uEFI SEL Log will show fatal error once you recover the system and boot into SEL log. 5. If there is a LCD Panel, CPU Over Temp error information will be displayed with details of affected CPU
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Socket 0~N (Intel MCERR on Socket 0~N error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'MCERR|machine.check|MCE_'; echo __MCERR_on_Socket_0~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

disposition_reason: Unlike the neighboring injectors, `injectMCERR()` carries no socket parameter even though the Items promise Socket 0~N. test_case.purpose: Inject an Intel MCERR into every required Socket 0~N target, verify the expected catastrophic crash/hang and recovery behavior, and correlate the affected CPU across BMC, UEFI, OS and physical indicators.
required_package: Board/CPU socket topology and exact `injectMCERR()` target/broadcast behavior
Supported Intel ITP/CScripts version, checksum and MCERR signature specification
Per-socket coverage plan if the command selects only one implicit target
Maximum hang/reboot interval, independent console and vendor recovery path
BMC/UEFI/OS fatal signatures plus front-panel/LCD event mapping
test_case.test_command: A qualified FAE/operator on a dedicated SUT applies the listed EDKII settings, confirms how the package's parameterless `injectMCERR()` selects or broadcasts a socket, performs one approved injection for the intended target, monitors the outage on an independent console, waits the defined recovery interval, gathers MCERR/catastrophic evidence and indicators after recovery, then restores settings and verifies health.
test_case.expected_result: 1. System should crash and hang but reboot eventually 2. BMC error log should record CPU Catastrophic Error been detected 3. If there is a LCD Panel, CPU Over Temp error information will be displayed with details of affected CPU

safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT, stable power, recovery console and explicit intentional-crash approval
Preserve logs instead of clearing the pre-existing baseline
Verify the implicit target before one bounded injection
Do not intervene during the protected autonomous-reboot interval except for defined aborts

expected_evidence: Harness version/hash and authoritative parameterless-target explanation
Per-target injection transcript with synchronized crash/hang/reboot timeline
Complete MCERR/MCE console or OS evidence, BMC catastrophic SEL and recovered UEFI fatal entry

test_case.recovery: Critical MCERR injection is permitted only after package and user/FAE gates; the review does not grant execution authority. Missing target or recovery information blocks that run but is not a DUT failure.

source_conflict.reason: The Items require Socket 0~N, but the source command accepts no socket argument and does not state its implicit target or iteration. `Reboot eventually` has no timeout, and CPU Over Temp on the LCD is unexplained for MCERR.
